content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) before submitting the UPPSC online application form. Applications submitted through any mode other than the official online system will not be accepted. The application process is completed through OTR authentication, submission of application details, payment of examination fee and final submission of the online application form.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for UPPSC Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility requirements prescribed for the respective post. The eligibility criteria differ according to the department and post.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Qualification
content_sections.text: The required qualification for Architectural Assistant, Estate Manager, Microbiologist, Manager (System), Senior Programmer, Programmer Grade-2 and Computer Operator Grade-B posts is given below.

rows.department: Uttar Pradesh Housing and Development Board
rows.educational_qualification: Candidates must have Intermediate with knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script along with a Diploma/Certificate in Architecture or a three-year full-time Architectural Assistantship course from a recognised institution. Candidates must also have required experience in architectural planning.

Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university. Preference will be given to candidates having MBA or PG Diploma in Management from a recognised university/institution. Knowledge of Hindi written in Devanagari script is also required.

Post Graduate Degree in Microbiology from a university established by law in India or a qualification recognised as equivalent by the Government. Candidates must also have at least three years of experience in microbiological testing of food.
Bachelor's Degree with Diploma in Computer Application from a recognised university/institution or equivalent qualification as prescribed by the department.
Bachelor's Degree with Diploma in Computer Application from a recognised university/institution or equivalent qualification as prescribed for the post.

Candidates must have a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university along with a Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Science from a recognised institute/university or A-Level Certificate from DOEACC (Government of India). Knowledge of software development, database systems, networking and office automation is required.
Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognised university with Diploma in Computer Application or equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit for UPPSC Recruitment 2026 varies according to the prescribed recruitment rules. Candidates must fulfil the age criteria as on 01 July 2026 . Age relaxation is applicable for eligible categories according to Uttar Pradesh Government rules. SC, ST, OBC candidates of Uttar Pradesh, skilled players, government employees and other eligible categories may receive relaxation as prescribed in the notification.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation benefits are available for eligible candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections of Uttar Pradesh according to applicable government rules. Horizontal reservation is also applicable for eligible categories including women candidates, dependents of freedom fighters, ex-servicemen and persons with disabilities as per rules.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for UPPSC Recruitment 2026 depends on the post applied for. The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission will conduct separate examinations for the advertised posts and select suitable candidates based on the prescribed selection procedure. For the posts of Architectural Assistant, Estate Manager and Microbiologist, UPPSC will conduct separate examinations at various examination centres in Uttar Pradesh. The selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the examination. For Manager (System), Senior Programmer and Programmer Grade-2 posts, selection will be based on marks obtained by candidates in the examination. For Computer Operator Grade-B, selection will be based on total marks obtained in the examination along with Hindi and English type test.

rows.selection_basis: Written Examination + Hindi & English Type Test

faq.question: Q1. What is UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UPPSC Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission for various posts including Architectural Assistant, Estate Manager, Microbiologist, Manager (System), Senior Programmer, Programmer Grade-2 and Computer Operator Grade-B.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 47 vacancies have been announced through the two UPPSC recruitment notifications.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are available under UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Architectural Assistant, Estate Manager, Microbiologist, Manager (System), Senior Programmer, Programmer Grade-2 and Computer Operator Grade-B.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification varies according to the post. Candidates may require Intermediate with diploma/certificate, Bachelor's Degree, Post Graduate Degree in Microbiology, Computer Application qualification or related technical qualifications depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age limit mentioned in the notification is 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2026. Age relaxation is available for eligible categories according to government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹225 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates, ₹105 for SC/ST and Ex-Servicemen candidates, and ₹25 for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for payment of examination fee and submission of online application is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official UPPSC website after completing mandatory One Time Registration (OTR).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes written examination for most posts. Computer Operator Grade-B candidates also have to appear for Hindi and English type tests.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary of UPPSC Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: The salary varies according to the post. The pay scale ranges from Level-5 to Level-7 and higher pay scales as mentioned in the recruitment notification.
